messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image, using the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character walks forward down the street, and the camera follows closely behind her.","camera":"A third-person follow camera positioned behind the character, moving forward and gradually zooming in on her upper body.","clothing":"A long-sleeved, plaid-patterned jumpsuit in orange, tan, and black with white cuffs, paired with black flat shoes.","hair_color":"Dark brown.","hairstyle":"Dark hair pulled back into a high bun.","identity":"A female character with a slim build, seen from behind, with a small tattoo visible on her left forearm.","scene":"A cobblestone street in a European-style town with brick buildings, shop awnings, and a Union Jack flag hanging on the left."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a sunny seaside terrace to a foggy cobblestone street with brick buildings, shop awnings, street lamps, and a Union Jack flag, matching the reference environment. The character remains seen from behind, walking forward in the same plaid outfit and high bun, with a similar follow camera that gradually moves closer.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the seaside terrace scene with the cobblestone European street from the reference, while preserving the same person, hairstyle, outfit, action, camera framing/movement, and natural lighting.
uncertain: Whether the character's facial expression was preserved, since she is mostly seen from behind.
unexpected_changes: The character's shadow on the street appears distorted and does not consistently match her pose or position.
The new scene is noticeably hazier and lower-contrast than the bright source scene, changing the overall lighting mood.
